extraction.Name: Florence Twiss Cuny
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee and refused to accept it at first, but that she was told that if she did not take it and pay the taxes that she would lose the land so, on the advise of the Farmer and Superintendent she took it
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Charles I. Moore & Co., Galena, Ill. for $600.00; sold to Ben Gall of Scenic, So. Dak. for $3000.00, he to pay all back taxes and pay the mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so she mortgaged it; found that she could not pay the mortgage or taxes so she had to sell the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband, who does common labor for a living
extraction.NOTES: Has seven children depending on her; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent; bought 160 acres of fair land with money from her allotment but has paid no taxes and does not know as to the title at this time; document references No. 818 and A22e4e; sworn December 3, 1928; State of South Dakota, County of Shannon | Allotment number recovered from source page review of original bundled PDF header, 2026-04-21. | SUBSTANTIVE CORRECTION 2026-04-29: BLM accession 709333 (Serial Patent, South Dakota, 9/29/1919) confirms canonical record details. Three Sonnet text-extraction errors corrected: (1) Name 'Twiis' is OCR misread of 'Twiss' (the s-s ligature read as i-i); (2) Allotment number 762 corrected to 818 — original Sonnet NOTES even captured the correct '818' as 'document references No. 818' but the primary field was set to 762; (3) Tribe normalized from 'Shannon County, SD (likely Pine Ridge or Rosebud)' to 'Pine Ridge' — BLM Tribe field reads 'Pine Ridge Sioux', and Florence's PO address (Rocky Ford, SD — a Pine Ridge community in Shannon County) confirms. Original allottee name on patent was 'Florence Twiss' (Cuny is married name; preserved as primary form per affidavit self-identification).
